title: Service guidance and button-reset instructions
summary: This topic clusters brief service-writer guidance about resets, button presses, app or phone behavior, and referrals to outside support, with most fragments too incomplete to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe service staff giving clear instructions or directing customers to the appropriate support resource for features like HomeLink or system resets.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unresolved issues being redirected elsewhere or framed conditionally, such as leaks or recurring problems needing outside follow-up.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly short, context-poor notes about explanations, unavailable options, button functions, or uncertain answers that do not clearly express satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short service-note excerpts with insufficient context to infer customer sentiment confidently.
The topic mixes several unrelated subjects, including mirror reset steps, HomeLink support, phone proximity behavior, navigation, radio mute functions, and app notifications.
Known-sentiment examples are limited, so the summary should not be treated as representative of all reviews in the topic.
